$comment: How the desktop app builds its Python runtime (docs/adr/ADR-011-desktop-app.md). Read by scripts/stage.mjs.

torchOverride.$comment: Replace the locked PyPI torch wheel with one from a PyTorch index. Bump the CUDA tag when torch is bumped: stage fails if the index has no wheel for the locked version.

ffmpeg.$comment: LGPL builds only (the app is not GPL). Windows/Linux: BtbN shared builds. macOS: built from source by scripts/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh.
